name: Hangzhou SF Intra-city Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou SF Intra-city Industrial Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, provides intra-city on-demand delivery services in the People's Republic of China. It covers the delivery of food, fresh produce, flowers, cakes and desserts, other groceries, apparel, jewelry, cosmetics, 3C electronics, as well as personal errands services, and task-based government and enterprise services, etc. The company offers software development and information technology services; procures equipment; software as a service (SaaS) solutions; and intracity delivery services.
